evidence.tag_40: Block medians sit at 120.40 for samples 0-390 then at 120.51 for 391-851: a +0.11 step, 7.4x the pooled MAD-sigma (0.0148) for this channel, and it never returns. tag_40 has no partner above |r|=0.5 in any of the 18 files and no other column in unit_01 moves more than 2.5 sd anywhere, so nothing in the process moved with it. Variance and lag-1 autocorrelation of differences are unchanged across the step (ac1d ~-0.65 either side), which is the signature of an added offset rather than a process change.

evidence.tag_22: tag_22 block medians are flat at 80.03-80.24 for samples 0-300 then climb monotonically to 81.49 by sample ~700 and stay there: +1.4 units = 5.5x pooled sigma (0.255), 15 noise-sd on a two-window median test. tag_22's coupled partners (tag_06, tag_25, tag_33, tag_10, tag_14, tag_46) are all flat to within 1.4 sd over the same stretch - tag_06's block medians stay in 2695-2716 with no trend - so the throughput that normally sets tag_22 did not move. Its own variance and autocorrelation are unchanged, so this is the reading drifting, not the purity.

evidence.tag_05: Median jumps from 41.05 to 44.90 between samples 90 and 100 (+3.64 = 6.6x pooled sigma 0.553, 31 noise-sd) and holds for the remaining 790 samples. tag_05 has no partner above |r|=0.5 in any of the 18 files, and no other column in unit_03 exceeds 2.4 sd anywhere in the file, so nothing moved with it.
